name: cross-warp-morph
title: Cross-Warp Morph
description: Both scenes displace along a shared FBM noise field in opposite directions. Noise-driven blend boundary. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.
useWhen: The picture should melt into the next one along an organic noise-shaped boundary.
A soft, abstract bridge between two scenes in different colours.
avoidWhen: The cut should read as a straight edit or a wipe.
Fine text sits in the middle of the frame during the cut: the warp bends it.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
